heading.title: Jurisdiction of the Criminal Courts in Inquiries and Trials

article.title: Power to order cases to be tried in different sessions divisions
article.content:
205Power to order cases to be tried in different sessions divisions

Section 205 · Chapter XIV
Notwithstanding anything contained in the preceding provisions of this Chapter, the State Government may direct that any case or class of cases committed for trial in any district may be tried in any sessions division:
ProvisoProvided that such direction is not repugnant to any direction previously issued by the High Court or the Supreme Court under the Constitution, or under this Sanhita or any other law for the time being in force.
